nameJa: Fullscreen Live Chat レトロゲーム
headline: Fullscreen / Live Chat
prompt:
Edit THIS exact original pixel-art night adventure promotional image. REPLACE "Stay for the chat." with TWO bold prominent amber pixel-font headline lines rendered EXACTLY "Fullscreen" then "Live Chat". CRITICAL: "Fullscreen" is a SINGLE WORD F-u-l-l-s-c-r-e-e-n, no space; "Live Chat" is TWOwords with a normal space. These are the main large hero words, both must be legible at440×280thumbnail, not only present as tinybrand. Adjustfont/reflow upper-leftsky headline so entire wordFullscreen fits with comfortablemargins and does not hitmoon/castle, then Live Chat below. Maintain chunky precise pixel-letterquality, increasecontrast where needed.
Keep the nocturnal originaladventure scene with red-scarfedtraveler and blackcat onstonebridge, floatingvillages, amberlanternwindows, waterfalls, teal/purplemountains and brightmoon. PreserveONE darkpurple pixelchat overlay atlower-right INSIDE the full-gamefield with3messages "nice run!", "LET'S GO", "GG!", and clearlyvisible "Say something..." input withyellow sendarrow. Tiny "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen" name can remain above mainheadline. Keep4tealfullscreencornerbrackets. Retain professional nostalgicpixelart craft. No known gameIP/realstreamers/logos/physicalmonitor/storestatusbadges.
Canvas mustremain11:7 aspectratio1.5714 (target1760×1120), complete moderately wide rectangular storetile. No ultrawidepanorama, cropping/squeezing/stretchingtext, blankbars or extra panels. Headline precisely "Fullscreen" / "Live Chat"; do not renderFull Screen. This is an originalconceptualillustration, not a real screenshot.
conceptNote: 緻密なピクセルアートの夜の冒険に、アンバーの機能名とチャット入力欄を重ねる。ゲーム配信の楽しさを伝える。 生成イラストであり実際のスクリーンショットではない。
